extractions.quote: Table 1 Diagnostic criteria for stiff person syndrome [1, 5] Diagnostic criteria Major criteria 1. Stiffness in the axial and limb muscles, prominently in the abdominal and thoracolumbar paraspinal muscles leading to a fixed deformity 2. Superimposed painful spasms precipitated by unexpected noises, emotional stress, or tactile stimuli 3. Confirmation of continuous motor unit activity in agonist and antagonist muscles by EMG 4. Absence of any other neurologic disease that could explain stiffness and rigidity
